findings.requirement: Browser Interface is the sole Browser-side Bus participant
Cookie identity contains no role or authority claim
Retained Master binding is Browser Interface state only
Race Control has no Browser identity/token/cookie dependency
Race Engine and Noticeboard have no Browser authority ownership
Session Definition contains no Browser identity
START authority remains Message Bus restricted
Request Results remain Race Control to Presentation only
Browser state is current Noticeboard state, not replay
Presentation loss cannot block Input/Race Engine
